title: reconcile: read and fold pending ADRs, flag a free later-tier story, and merge its own pull requests
story: /reconcile now reads the decision records waiting to go into the PRD, so a story one of them asks for no longer shows as unasked-for. It reports a decision record not yet folded in and a later-tier story that nothing blocks, offers to fold a record into the PRD (changing its status line in the same pull request a person merges), and merges a bookmark-only pull request on green.
no_qa_reason: Skill instructions only; suite checks guard the new findings, the status-line wording and the merge rule.
